notes.title: Survival Edition is here!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Implemented different levels of difficulty for puzzles: Easy / Medium / Hard
[*] Implemented a new system for bite attacks from enemies
[*] Added daggers to defense against enemies
[*] Improved graphics with better textures and a new lighting quality for high-end computers
[*] Changes in cameras to improve visual experience
[*] Changes in levels to improve decoration
[*] Added new playable sequences, more puzzles and new clues
[*] Added new cinematics for storytelling
[*] Improved AI of the enemies
[*] Improved player aiming system
[*] Better optimization for low-end computers
[*] Added new sounds and voices for enemies
[/list]

notes.title: First weeks summary patch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35920245/be184fa55392e3dffbce012e6618df916961bdf9.jpg[/img]
- Implemented full-controller support
- Improved player movement with keyboard
- Added new different sounds for opening doors
- Added documents explaining keboard and gamepad controls
- Added mission to find savegame room
- Fixed issue with achievements
- Fixed glitches with some doors
- Fixed crash when shooting Beresford grandma
- Fixed readability of some documents
- Fixed bug with Stones/Altar puzzle
- Fixed issue where gamepad/keyboard icons changes when pressing space bar
- Fixed bug displaying gamepad icons when playing QTE with keyboard
- Fixed bugs in settings menu
- Fixed issues reloading weapons
- Fixed translations issues

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35920245/8084e29ee372cb3e9ae983eb231ef21a4c5e3b30.jpg[/img]
What to expect in next updates?
- Improve combat mode
- Fix russian translations
- Implement GPU recognition on laptops
- Improve performance
